help.title: Help
help.whatIsText: ainonyproxy is a privacy proxy for LLMs. It detects personal information (PII) in your messages, masks it before sending it to the AI provider, and unmasks the response for you.
help.step1: Configure your application or client to point to the ainonyproxy endpoint instead of the direct LLM provider.
help.step2: Send your requests to the endpoint: /api/ai/{provider} (e.g. /api/ai/openai).
help.step3: ainonyproxy will automatically detect PII, mask it with markers like <PERSON_1>, send the safe message to the LLM, and unmask the response.
help.step4: Check the Overview tab to see request statistics, detected entities, and logs.
help.providersText: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Kimi, Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, Z.ai and llama.cpp. They are configured in /opt/ainonyproxy/config/api_urls.json and their keys in /opt/ainonyproxy/config/api_keys.json.
help.dashboardText: The Overview tab shows the processed requests, the detected PII entities, scan times, and logs in real time. It refreshes itself every 5 seconds.
help.docsText: Every endpoint under /api/ is documented, and can be tried, at /api/doc/.

auth.title: Log in
auth.subtitle: Access the ainonyproxy dashboard
auth.forgotHint: Without a recovery code, an administrator can set a new password from the dashboard, or from the server terminal (see the MANUAL).

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Get your own access to the ainonyproxy dashboard
register.hint: Username: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (up to 64). Password: at least 8 characters.
register.closed: The registration is closed. Ask an administrator to create an account for you.

recover.title: Recover your password
recover.subtitle: Set a new password with the recovery code of your account.
recover.done: Your password has been changed and every session of your account has been closed.
recover.newCodeText: The recovery code you used no longer works. This is your new one: it is shown only this once, so copy it or write it down and keep it in a safe place.

recoveryCode.saveText: It is the only way to set a new password by yourself if you forget it. It is shown only this once: copy it or write it down, and keep it in a safe place.
recoveryCode.savedCheck: I have saved my recovery code
recoveryCode.title: Recovery code
recoveryCode.accountText: If you forget your password, your recovery code lets you set a new one at /auth/recover/. Generating a new code makes the previous one stop working.
recoveryCode.statusYes: You have had a recovery code since {date}.
recoveryCode.statusNo: You do not have a recovery code yet. Generate one and keep it in a safe place.
recoveryCode.generatedText: The previous code no longer works. Save this one: it is shown only this once.
recoveryCode.userCreatedText: Give this recovery code to {username}: it lets them set a new password by themselves. It is shown only this once.

users.title: Dashboard users
users.confirmDeleteText: The user {username} and all their sessions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
users.resetText: The user will have to log in again with the new password.
users.registrationLabel: Anybody can create an account at /auth/register/ (always with the role User)

account.title: Your account
account.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been closed.

api.title: Connect your applications
api.intro: Send OpenAI-compatible chat requests to the endpoint of the provider you want. ainonyproxy masks the personal data before it leaves this computer and unmasks the answer.
api.certificateNote: If the server uses its self-signed certificate, tell your client to trust it (with curl: -k).
